content.text:
Root cause: `http://172.19.0.1` is not a secure browser context. `localhost` receives a special exemption.

Reproduced in Chromium:

- `http://localhost`: `isSecureContext=true`, `crypto.subtle=true`
- `http://172.19.0.1`: `isSecureContext=false`, `crypto.subtle=false`

ALTCHA requires `crypto.subtle`. Therefore:

1. `POST /session` successfully creates the challenge.
2. `solveChallengeWorkers()` starts.
3. Workers cannot use Web Crypto.
4. Its promise remains pending, so `PUT /session` is never called.

ALTCHA officially lists Web Crypto/`crypto.subtle` as a browser requirement. [ALTCHA documentation](https://github.com/altcha-org/altcha)

Use HTTPS when accessing testcenter through an IP or hostname. For local Chrome-only testing, the browser flag `--unsafely-treat-insecure-origin-as-secure=http://172.19.0.1` can confirm the diagnosis, but it is not a deployment fix.

There is also a minor URL issue:

```ts
`${window.document.baseURI}/altcha-lib/dist/worker.js`
```

When `baseURI` ends with `/`, this produces `//altcha-lib/...`. It should eventually use:

```ts
new URL('altcha-lib/dist/worker.js', window.document.baseURI).href
```

That is not the hostname-dependent root cause. No code changed.
